stories.headline: For everything from troubled hearts to lost keys, Greeks bake cakes for a wish-granting saint
stories.summary: A large gathering of worshippers converged just outside Athens this week, journeying to a sanctuary dedicated to Saint Fanourios. Carrying homemade treats, the faithful filled the grounds to present their gifts in hope of heavenly guidance. The traditional practice welcomes anyone seeking comfort in difficult times or help with life's everyday petitions.
